title: State and availability of a web app

kind.description: ARM kind: app, app,linux, functionapp, functionapp,linux ...

state.description: Running or Stopped, as Azure reports it

enabled.description: The app is enabled; false means disabled

availabilityState.description: Normal, Limited or DisasterRecoveryMode; null when Azure gives none

limited.description: availabilityState is Limited; null when it is not reported (DisasterRecoveryMode is named by availabilityState, not by this flag)

usageState.description: Normal or Exceeded (a quota of the plan was used up); null when not reported

quotaExceeded.description: usageState is Exceeded; null when it is not reported

suspendedTill.description: When the app is suspended until (quota exceeded)

planName.description: The App Service plan the app runs on; null when it has none (Container Apps hosting)

planResourceGroup.description: The plan's resource group, which may differ from the app's
